title: Paper Bridge · Teams
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Paper Bridge · Teams with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Place the books a short distance apart and give the lead a sheet of paper. The lead folds the paper to span the gap between the books. The paper spans the gap without falling for five seconds. Form two teams. Each team has four turns; only the lead’s teammates respond or assist. Each success earns the team one point. The higher team score wins; ties are shared.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 4–8 players; materials: One sheet of paper and two books.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Paper Bridge, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
The paper spans the gap without falling for five seconds.
recall.why: The paper spans the gap without falling for five seconds.

game.materials: One sheet of paper and two books
